howItWorks.title: Professional-grade valuation, <1>made transparent</1>.
howItWorks.intro: Valuing art has always needed experienced gallerists — the parameters are complex and qualitative. Vaayu applies that same discipline with AI: consistently, transparently, and at scale. Here is exactly how the number is built.
howItWorks.layer1Body: Every tradition and medium has a market rate — often expressed per square foot. Vaayu starts from that benchmark (e.g. Mithila, Warli, oil, print), the same square-foot logic galleries use.
howItWorks.layer2Body: The artist's standing moves the price up or down. Vaayu weighs the gallerist's checklist (below) and places the work on a tier — emerging, mid-career, established, or renowned.
howItWorks.layer3Body: Finally, the specific piece: condition, size, materials, theme rarity, and provenance. A standout example earns a premium; problems earn a discount — what curators have always done by intuition.
howItWorks.formula: Estimate = base value × artist multiplier × work adjustment, shown as a low–mid–high range with a confidence score.
howItWorks.checklistLead: Before paying for a work, run through these. Vaayu weighs the same parameters in Layer 2 — and the more of this you can add (in the artist name and provenance notes), the sharper and more confident the estimate.
howItWorks.q1: What is the artist's education and training?
howItWorks.q2: Where have they exhibited, and with whom?
howItWorks.q3: Do they show range across styles, subjects, and mediums?
howItWorks.q4: Who are their collectors? Any institutions or respected names?
howItWorks.q5: Is the artist's work featured in credible publications?
howItWorks.q6: Does the per-square-foot rate align with all of the above?
howItWorks.q7: Are you buying from a reputed gallery or curator?
howItWorks.q8: Having seen enough other work, does the price feel right to your conviction?
howItWorks.q9: Is the price grounded in quality — or inflated by hype?
howItWorks.hypeBody: a high price should be grounded in quality and verifiable standing — not hype. When the inputs don't justify a high figure, Vaayu keeps the estimate conservative and lowers the confidence score, rather than inflating both.
